experiment: E8: re-test prefetch depth after cw4 made compute faster
rationale: cw4 sped up the compute loops, so the pipeline balance might have shifted from compute-bound to DMA-bound, making deeper prefetch useful where E1 (at cw1) found it flat
conclusion: even after cw4, deeper prefetch (versions/stages 3, 4) is flat (~0.145 ms) and rows=8/2 are worse. The rebalance hypothesis is wrong: prefetch depth is not the lever at any point.
decision: KEEP rows=4 versions=2 cw=4. Confirms the earlier finding independently under the faster compute.
